summary: Register provider-independent review-at-head claim readers and preserve their audit references before gate activation.

replay.detail: No projection or mission replay is introduced. Unknown authenticated records can be retried unchanged after upgrading readers.

schema.detail: Add four gate-operation append kinds and nine gate.requested extension fields. Nested change/head identities are validated explicitly. Change kinds are open namespaced identifiers; tagged head formats and existing subject families remain checked. No local table or client contract changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules version advances from 15 to 16 to preserve review binding, withdrawal, verdict, evidence and exact author-attempt references. All four kinds and existing gate/document claims remain durable. The reader release must precede activation; activation itself must not introduce a rules-digest change.

compatibility.detail: Older peers quarantine the new kinds or request fields as unknown, retaining authenticated original bytes for upgrade retry. This release does not publish review-at-head declarations, advertise readiness or activate review gates. Existing human gate mode and verdict enums are unchanged.

manual.detail: Deploy upgraded readers before any later review-at-head activation. Mixed rules versions cannot agree on a new checkpoint; no authoritative evidence is trimmed to reconcile them.

recovery.detail: Existing unknown-record retry and checkpoint agreement mechanisms remain in use. No record replacement or cache authority is introduced.

downtime.detail: Ordinary binary restart; no measured downtime claim.
